origin_provenance.description: The retained before source and test originated as byte-identical copies of the staged Chapter 12 support files used for the captured session.

before_fixture.provenance: Package-local retained copies of the actual staged Chapter 12 support source and test.

patch.generation: Machine-generated unified diff from the immutable before source to the disposable patched source using stable a/ and b/ labels.

human_contract.representation: Condensed in session.md without changing the bounded behavior, approval policy, write scope, blocker conditions, or rollout boundary.

approval_basis.standing_direction: Choose the best implementation without another approval checkpoint.
approval_basis.agent_selected_implementation: Leave the existing numerator path unchanged and divide only by the explicit count of succeeded and failed attempts.
approval_basis.rationale: This is the strict smaller patch and preserves pending and unknown-state behavior.

minimality_review.initial_candidate: Changed the filtered list, numerator predicate, early return, and denominator.
minimality_review.final_candidate: Changes only the final denominator expression.

transcript.observations_plan_actions_and_results: Contemporaneous record of actual tool-backed actions.
transcript.command_output: Command output with the disposable traceback path normalized to <WORK>; elapsed time is normalized only during replay comparison.

policy_decision.denominator: Include every succeeded and failed terminal attempt.
policy_decision.required_future_basis: Representative benchmark scope plus operational evidence beyond this fixture.

initial_one_sentence_plan: Build one list containing only succeeded and failed attempts, return zero when that list is empty, count a pass only when a terminal attempt both succeeded and met the quality minimum, and divide by the terminal count without changing pending or threshold behavior.
one_sentence_plan: Leave the existing successful-attempt list, passing count, and early return unchanged; replace only the final denominator with the count of attempts whose status is explicitly succeeded or failed.
normalization: Stored red evidence replaces the machine-specific disposable traceback path with <WORK>. Replay comparison also normalizes that path and elapsed-time values emitted by unittest.
replay_dependency_scope: All replay inputs and checksum targets are inside the final Chapter 12 package. Repository paths and original hashes are retained as provenance only and are not resolved or verified at replay time.

independent_review.method: Read-only review using a disposable package copy and an independently assembled package-local fixture
independent_review.attribution_limit: The human contract is condensed and non-verbatim, and the mixed contemporaneous transcript is not claimed as an unavailable verbatim conversation log.
independent_review.advisory_follow_up: The shared session ledger still maps Chapter 12 to the historical support tree; that publication-control update remains outside this package integration.
